book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Life Behind the Lens 镜头背后
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第三册 Unit 2 词表(p14-23 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、摄影/手艺/匠心(Bill Cunningham·王津修钟·梅兰芳)主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: He looked at the busy street through the lens of his old camera.
words.example_cn: 他透过老相机的镜头看着繁忙的街道。

words.example_en: Every famous person in the city wanted to pose for this quiet photographer.
words.example_cn: 城里每个名人都想为这位安静的摄影师摆姿势拍照。

words.example_en: He once photographed a man buying oranges at a small grocery store.
words.example_cn: 他曾拍下一个男人在小杂货店买橙子的场景。

words.example_en: His fascination with what ordinary people wore shaped all of his work.
words.example_cn: 他对普通人穿着的着迷塑造了他全部的作品。

words.example_en: He believed that fashion belonged to everyone, not only to the rich.
words.example_cn: 他相信时尚属于每个人,而不仅属于富人。

words.meaning_cn: 不复杂的,简单的;单纯的
words.example_en: Although he was world-famous, his approach to life was simple and uncomplicated.
words.example_cn: 尽管举世闻名,他对生活的态度却简单而不复杂。

words.example_en: He refused free flights to faraway places that others would envy.
words.example_cn: 他拒绝了别人会羡慕的、飞往遥远之地的免费机票。

words.example_en: Even at a celebrity party, he was there to work rather than to have fun.
words.example_cn: 即使在名人聚会上,他也是去工作而不是去玩乐。

words.example_en: He stayed focused on his craft and never chased money or fame.
words.example_cn: 他专注于自己的手艺,从不追逐金钱或名声。

words.example_en: People called him a cultural anthropologist who recorded a whole city's life.
words.example_cn: 人们称他为记录了整座城市生活的文化人类学家。

words.example_en: She grew the rare plants by much trial and error.
words.example_cn: 她经过反复试验才把这些珍稀植物种活。

words.example_en: The spirit of craftsmanship shows in every careful detail of his work.
words.example_cn: 匠心精神体现在他作品的每一处用心细节中。

words.example_en: His skill at his work had already won him wide acclaim.
words.example_cn: 他在工作上的技艺早已为他赢得了广泛赞誉。

words.example_en: He sought no fame and chose to shun the spotlight all his life.
words.example_cn: 他不求名声,一生都选择避开聚光灯。

words.example_en: Although famous, he always preferred to stay out of the spotlight.
words.example_cn: 尽管出名,他始终更愿待在聚光灯之外。

words.example_en: The scientists kept working under harsh desert conditions for years.
words.example_cn: 科学家们在恶劣的沙漠条件下持续工作了多年。

words.example_en: Their efforts helped build a stronger and more prosperous country.
words.example_cn: 他们的努力帮助建设了一个更强大、更繁荣的国家。

words.example_en: In the quiet courtyard, time seemed to move at its own pace.
words.example_cn: 在安静的庭院里,时间仿佛按自己的节奏流动。

words.example_en: These masters have spent their lives restoring precious antiques.
words.example_cn: 这些大师们用一生修复珍贵的古董。

words.example_en: Wang Jin repairs antique clocks that are hundreds of years old.
words.example_cn: 王津修复着已有数百年历史的古董钟表。

words.example_en: Each timepiece needs its own careful method of restoration.
words.example_cn: 每件计时器都需要自己独特而细致的修复方法。

words.example_en: He walked through the seven crimson gates to reach his workshop.
words.example_cn: 他穿过七道深红色的大门来到自己的工作室。

words.phrase_en: on the way to the workplace
words.example_en: Admirers often stop him on the way to his workplace for a photo.
words.example_cn: 仰慕者常在他去工作场所的路上拦住他合影。

words.example_en: The museum holds one of the finest collections of timepieces in the world.
words.example_cn: 这座博物馆收藏着世界上最精美的计时器藏品之一。

words.example_en: Foreign envoys once presented these emperors with splendid clocks.
words.example_cn: 外国使节曾向这些皇帝进献华丽的钟表。

words.example_en: The intricate clock has thousands of tiny moving parts inside it.
words.example_cn: 这座错综复杂的钟内部有成千上万个微小的活动部件。

words.example_en: Each expert can repair a maximum of two large pieces a year.
words.example_cn: 每位专家一年最多只能修复两件大型作品。

words.meaning_cn: 小心的;费尽心思的;精心的
words.example_en: Through their painstaking efforts, the old clocks slowly come back to life.
words.example_cn: 通过他们精心的努力,旧钟表慢慢恢复了生机。

words.example_en: The only sound in his workshop is the chiming of repaired clocks.
words.example_cn: 他工作室里唯一的声音是修好的钟表的报时声。

words.example_en: To him, the chiming melody of the clocks is the best music in the world.
words.example_cn: 对他来说,钟表报时的曲调是世界上最美的音乐。

words.example_en: He carefully cleaned and polished every part of the old clock.
words.example_cn: 他仔细地清洁并擦亮了旧钟的每一个部件。

words.example_en: At last he wound up the gigantic clocks from the time of Qianlong.
words.example_cn: 最后他给乾隆时期的巨型钟表上紧了发条。

words.example_en: When the clock comes to life, tiny model dogs bark and birds flap their wings.
words.example_cn: 当钟表运转起来,小小的模型狗会吠叫,鸟儿会扑动翅膀。

words.example_en: On the old clock, a little figure of a woman begins to spin.
words.example_cn: 在那座旧钟上,一个小小的女子塑像开始旋转。

words.example_en: Saying that these antiques have lives is no exaggeration at all.
words.example_cn: 说这些古董有生命绝非夸张。

words.example_en: He used a metaphor to describe how the old clocks seem alive.
words.example_cn: 他用一个隐喻来描述旧钟表如何仿佛是活的。

words.example_en: The work may never be finished; nonetheless, he remains hopeful.
words.example_cn: 这项工作也许永远做不完;尽管如此,他依然满怀希望。

words.example_en: A new generation of artisans will carry the craft into the future.
words.example_cn: 新一代工匠将把这门手艺带向未来。

words.example_en: Their work helps preserve traditional skills for the future.
words.example_cn: 他们的工作有助于为未来保存传统技艺。

words.example_en: In our fast world, the saying "time waits for no man" seems very apt.
words.example_cn: 在我们快节奏的世界里,"时不待人"这句话显得格外恰当。

words.meaning_cn: 永恒的,恒久的;永不过时的
words.example_en: There is something timeless about the way these masters work.
words.example_cn: 这些大师工作的方式中有一种永恒的东西。

words.example_en: They piece together the past with skilful hands and modest hearts.
words.example_cn: 他们用灵巧的双手和谦逊的心拼接起过去。

words.example_en: She wrote an expository essay about a famous craftworker.
words.example_cn: 她写了一篇关于一位著名手艺人的说明文。

words.example_en: For seven generations, the Lei family came to dominate imperial building.
words.example_cn: 七代人间,雷氏家族逐渐主宰了皇家建筑。

words.example_en: Their work in architecture ranged from grand halls to roads and dams.
words.example_cn: 他们在建筑上的作品从宏伟的殿堂到道路和水坝无所不包。

words.meaning_cn: 宏大的,艰巨的;有抱负的
words.example_en: Each generation took on ambitious projects that lasted for years.
words.example_cn: 每一代人都承担了历时数年的宏大工程。

words.example_en: People still associate these great works with the court rather than the family.
words.example_cn: 人们仍把这些伟大作品与朝廷而非这个家族联系在一起。

words.example_en: The main body of the essay comprises facts and supporting evidence.
words.example_cn: 这篇文章的主体由事实和支撑性证据构成。
